text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san, thank you for the present. I 
have looked at it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still, how curious. Only one glove when it 
should be a pair. To think you would offer 
an "incomplete" gift.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, you are correct. ...Or rather, that 
look on your face...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Please don't mind me. Go right 
ahead. You want to say it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
......Yes, I'll gladly take you up on 
that, then.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This is not the place to present the other 
one. In accordance with ancient 
traditions—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'll slam it right into you on the 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ufufu...! How classic! Just like a 
challenger's etude!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still, so that is your answer. Well, I 
have no reason to decline.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Then one more thing: add a fierce 
victory worthy of the day of my birth.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we haven't prepared any of that. Not 
anywhere, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: No—I am already touching it, you see.
